Description: Maxi.Wash Detox Shampoo is a deep cleansing shampoo that removes product build up, dirt and excess oil from hair. Created with a herbal blend of Lime, Mint and Eucalyptus to remove excess oil and stimulates the scalp. This product is suitable for sensitive scalps and all hair types that require a deep clean to return hair to its former glory.
Melaleuca Quinquenervia (Niaouli) Oil: A hair softener which also relieves skin conditions and speeding up the healing process.
Carica Papaya (Papaya) Fruit Extract: AHAs that exfoliate the scalp by dissolving dead skin cells.
Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract: Reduces scalp inflammation to promote healthy hair growth.
Thymus Vulgaris (Thyme) Extract: Antioxidant that improves colour retention.
Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Distillate: A natural antiseptic to detoxify the hair and scalp.
Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice: Moisturises, refreshes and heals the scalp.
Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Oil: Helps to penetrate the scalp and relieve dry, flaky skin, promoting long, healthy, and shiny hair
Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract: Improves blood circulation to promote a healthy scalp, and antioxidants protect the hair.
Citrus Grandis (Grapefruit) Extract: Promotes hair growth, and is cellular regenerative.
Salvia Officinalis (Sage) Oil: Detoxifies and deeply cleanses. Soothes hair and scalp.
To use: Apply to wet hair and gently massage into hair and scalp, rinse and repeat.
